Partition a grid into tiles

Source: R/lattice.R
grid_tiles.Rd

Pure index arithmetic: how many tiles fit and what their extents are. Tiles are enumerated left to right, then top to bottom, matching cell order. Edge tiles may be smaller than tile_dim. Every tile is aligned to the parent and grid_offset() of a tile is its origin in parent cells.

grid_tiles(dimension, extent = NULL, tile_dim = c(256L, 256L))

Arguments

dimension

integer ncol, nrow

extent

numeric extent xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax

tile_dim

tile dimension (ncol, nrow), recycled if length 1

Value

list of lists, each with dimension and extent, plus offset (the tile's 0-based c(col, row) origin in the parent)

Examples

tl <- grid_tiles(c(10L, 7L), c(0, 10, 0, 7), c(4L, 4L))
length(tl)
#> [1] 6
tl[[6]]
#> $dimension
#> [1] 2 3
#> 
#> $extent
#> [1]  8 10  0  3
#> 
#> $offset
#> col row 
#>   8   4 
#>
